title: Connection Manager ForwardOpen-shaped unconnected request with bounded connection path
purpose: Cover the Connection Manager parser path mentioned by the issue with a compact ForwardOpen-shaped request embedded in SendRRData, using a short well-bounded connection path instead of malformed path accounting.

messages.label: RegisterSession then SendRRData with Connection Manager ForwardOpen analogue

expected_behavior: A harness that splits the concatenated seed into sequential frames should first establish a session and then parse an unconnected explicit message aimed at Connection Manager. The target should either reject unsupported ForwardOpen details with a normal CIP error or continue safely through bounded connection-path parsing.
constraints_preserved: Uses RegisterSession followed by SendRRData because issue summaries describe a reachable unconnected explicit-message path through encapsulation to CIP parsing.
SendRRData CPF uses exactly the documented common pair: Null Address Item and Unconnected Data Item.
Embedded CIP service 0x54 is treated as ForwardOpen-shaped based on common EtherNet/IP knowledge; this service assignment is an inferred assumption not explicitly present in supplied sources.
Path bytes 20062401 are a conservative inferred class/instance route to Connection Manager object instance 1, included to drive parser coverage without malformed path sizing.
The trailing connection path is short and even-length to avoid the parser-accounting defects described by the issue.
issue_safety_notes: The connection path is deliberately tiny and internally bounded; no odd-sized, truncated, or count-mismatched path fields are used, and no exact historical malformed ForwardOpen payload is reproduced.
